location.title: Add an Időkép location
location.description: Type the name of a Hungarian place as it is written on idokep.hu, for example Érd or Balatonfüred.

data_description.location: Settlement name. Accents are optional: "erd" works for Érd.

station.title: Add a map station
station.description: Enter the station name or Időkép station ID. Each station is added as a separate device.

data_description.measurement_point: Use the exact station name or its Időkép identifier.

smog.title: Add smog sensors
smog.description: Choose a city available on the Időkép smog map. Leave the field empty to cancel.

data_description.smog_city: The selected city's smog stations will be added as sensors.

pollen.title: Add pollen sensors
pollen.description: Choose a city available on the Időkép pollen map. Leave the field empty to cancel.

data_description.pollen_city: The selected city's pollen levels will be added as sensors.

reconfigure.title: Change the location
reconfigure.description: Entity IDs stay the same, so dashboards and automations keep working.

data_description.location: Settlement name, as written on idokep.hu.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to idokep.hu. Try again later.
error.location_not_found: No weather data found on idokep.hu for this location.
error.location_fallback: idokep.hu does not know this place and shows {shown} instead. Check the spelling.
error.station_not_found: No map measurements found for this station. Check the station name or ID.
error.station_required: Enter a station name or ID.

abort.already_configured: This location or station is already added.
abort.radar_no_options: The global radar entry has no options.
abort.sensor_no_options: This sensor entry has no configurable options.
abort.map_unavailable: Could not load the Időkép map. Try again later.
abort.no_smog_cities: No cities with smog measurements were found.
abort.no_pollen_cities: No cities with pollen measurements were found.
abort.city_not_selected: No city was selected, so no sensor entry was added.
abort.city_not_available: The selected city is no longer available on the map.

init.title: Időkép options
init.description: The 30-day forecast needs one more download from idokep.hu per update. Add map stations, smog sensors and pollen sensors as separate Időkép entries.

station.title: Map station options
station.description: Set how often this station's measurements are refreshed. This interval is independent for each station.
